common: Animate THIS exact image. Keep exactly the same chibi characters (same faces, same eyes, same hair, same clothes, same body sizes), same background, same flat pastel cartoon style as the input image. Static locked-off shot, no zoom, no camera movement. Nobody talks to the camera: mouths are smiling, laughing or still unless stated. Natural gentle movements, nobody jumps around. Do not add any text, letters, numbers, people or new objects. Do NOT add any sparkles, stars, glitter, light bursts or glow effects.

clips.K1: The elevator doors stay open at first. The tattooed man inside politely holds the door and gestures with an open hand for the young man to come in. The young man, standing upright, glances at the tattoo, hesitates, then gives a small polite shake of the head and a little wave meaning 'I will take the next one' and stays outside. The silver doors slowly slide closed. Calm natural movement, nobody crouches. Mouths closed.
clips.K2: The brown-haired young man looks at the small flyer in his hand with growing curiosity, lowers it, and walks slowly in through the open glass door into the bright library with a small interested smile. His mouth stays closed.
clips.K3: The librarian presses the stamp onto the small card and hands it over with a kind smile. The young man takes the card, glances at it briefly, then turns his head toward the reading room where people are talking in pairs, looking curious. Nobody talks to the camera.
clips.K4: Slow, calm atmosphere: at each table the pairs keep talking warmly face to face - the grandmother gestures gently, the chef laughs and his partner nods, the woman in the wheelchair smiles while speaking. Small natural head nods and hand gestures only.
clips.K5: The young man's finger rests on the one portrait card; his eyes widen a little more in surprise, he leans slightly closer to the card, then blinks. His mouth stays in a small surprised 'o', no talking.
clips.K6: The tattooed man speaks gently and calmly to the young man, his open hand moving slowly; he glances down at his tattooed forearm. The young man sits a little stiff, listening, mouth CLOSED, then nods once. The sand in the hourglass keeps falling slowly.
clips.K7: Memory scene: the firefighter runs steadily away from the burning house toward the viewer, holding the crying little girl tight against his chest and shielding her head with his hand. Flames flicker and grey smoke drifts from the windows. No new people appear.
clips.K8: Warm memory scene: the firefighter kneels and holds the little girl close to protect her, his raised arm holding the burning wooden beam above them. Orange light flickers and smoke drifts slowly. He stays strong and determined, keeping her safe.
clips.K9: Quiet sad moment on a moving bus, soft light sliding over the windows. The man keeps his hands on his knees and slowly lowers his head, looking down sadly; his mouth stays closed. The mother glances at his scarred forearm and gently draws her son closer behind her; the boy peeks out, then hides. Nobody talks.
clips.K10: The tattoo artist carefully finishes the last feather of the phoenix with small precise movements, then lifts the machine away. The man turns his forearm slightly to look at the finished tattoo and smiles peacefully. Mouths stay closed.
clips.K11: The tattooed man holds the phone toward the young man and smiles proudly, talking softly. The young man leans in to look at the photo, his eyes glistening, and slowly nods, deeply moved; his mouth stays closed. The sand in the hourglass keeps falling.
clips.K12: Warm calm atmosphere: at each table the human books keep sharing their stories - the grandmother points to her old photo, the woman in the wheelchair talks with soft hand gestures, the chef laughs; each reader listens and nods attentively.
clips.K13: The young man keeps his right hand on his chest and bows his head slightly toward the tattooed man in sincere thanks, then straightens up; the tattooed man smiles warmly and they shake hands firmly. The hourglass on the table stays empty. Mouths closed or gently smiling.
clips.K14: LOCKED camera, no camera movement at all. The young man is seen in SIDE PROFILE the whole time and walks steadily from the left side of the frame toward the RIGHT side of the frame, crossing the picture horizontally - he never turns toward the viewer and never walks toward the camera. While walking he turns his head slightly to look around with a warm thoughtful smile; the old security guard on the right waves and the young man nods back. The vendor and passers-by stay where they are, nobody fades or disappears. Mouth closed or gently smiling.
clips.K15a: DIRECTION: everything moves toward the LEFT. The young man keeps pushing the heavy fruit cart steadily toward the LEFT until its wheels roll up over the low curb; the grandmother keeps walking toward the LEFT in front of the cart, turning only her head back to nod and smile at him gratefully. Nobody turns to the viewer. Calm, warm movement.
clips.K15b: DIRECTION: both walk toward the RIGHT. The young man lifts the top two heavy boxes off the young woman's stack and carries them easily; she turns her head to him and smiles and nods in thanks; then both keep walking side by side toward the RIGHT, toward the shop door. Nobody turns to the viewer. Natural steady walking.
